title: Wider manifestation of low-cost syringe-based printer for realizing printed organic electronic devices and supercapacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5028-5043
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00768B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Donjo George, Aman Khatkar, Vamsi Krishna G, Lubna Khanam, Yogesh Yadav, Ramesh Gupta Burela, Samarendra Pratap Singh
A low-cost syringe-based printer enables sustainable fabrication of organic solar cells, organic field-effect transistors, and supercapacitors, demonstrating its versatility and potential for scalable, eco-friendly printed electronics.
